description.value: Great Canadian Liquor Warehouse is an established Cranbrook liquor retailer operating since 2005, offering a wide selection of beer, wine, and spirits. The store takes pride in stocking local Kootenay craft breweries including Fisher Peak Brewing Company, Fernie Brewing Company, and Encore Brewing. For touring cyclists passing through Cranbrook, it is a convenient stop to pick up local craft beers and other refreshments.
